mechanism: Replaced gradient.exp() with a crate-local exp: range reduction (x = k*ln2 + r, |r| <= ln2/2) into a degree-7 Taylor polynomial for e^r, times 2^k by exact repeated doubling (a local pow2, never powi). Argument clamped to [-30, 30] first, which changes no caller-visible outcome since update's caller already clamps the result into [MIN_WEIGHT, MAX_WEIGHT] (a 1e8 span exp(20) already exceeds). update takes exp as a fn(f64) -> f64 parameter so the test suite can pass f64::exp back in as an independent reference without duplicating the method. Added clippy.toml (workspace root) with disallowed-methods over the full f32/f64 transcendental family, enforcing ADR-0024 crate-wide; the three pre-existing encoder-only log2 sites (filters.rs x2, lz.rs x1) carry a justified #[allow]. bench/clippy.toml overrides the list back to empty since bench/'s corpus generators never touch a bitstream. Round trip: existing suite unchanged and still green.

mechanism: Added rep_match_len (src/lz.rs), a per-distance carry mirroring next_match_candidate: match_len(i,d)=len implies match_len(i+1,d)>=len-1, so a later position on the same distance decrements instead of rescanning. Two follow-on bugs found and fixed during verification: a slot-index-keyed carry went stale on RepCache reorders (ties are common once a run passes MAX_MATCH_LEN), reproducing the same quadratic cost one level up; fixed by searching carry entries by distance value. A distance-keyed carry then went stale when a distance dropped out of every rep slot for a stretch and reappeared later; fixed by storing the position each entry was measured at and computing a saturating elapsed-adjusted lower bound at lookup time. Verified by direct timing (200,000 bytes: >60s before, <1s after; 50k-800k measured consistent with linear scaling) and a new wall-clock-bounded regression test, not just the round-trip suite.
